C-SAFE-DELIVERY.IntentSummary: Execute the owner's explicitly approved sequential preservation and integration directive with a fail-closed commit/push gate before any new commit or push.
C-SAFE-DELIVERY.ApprovalBasis: 2026-10-19 owner directive: steps 1, 2 and 3 approved, integrate after each task, discuss step 4 later, mobile fully independent of desktop commits/releases, mandatory local-model safety review and recheck before every commit and push.

T-001.Title: Preserve recoverable refs and private dirty layers

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Recovery refs and private file/hash manifests exist; no raw backup is staged or pushed.

T-002.Title: Implement, test, self-review and install the mandatory gate

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Static scanner, local two-pass model review, identity recheck and shared hooks fail closed; meaningful tests pass.

T-003.Title: Land the gate as its own desktop integration task

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Commit and outgoing push pass the installed gate and fresh CI; subsequent tasks use it.
